nodes.name: agent_core_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Wire-side adapter that registers this crate's SQLite-backed implementations into agent_core's IoC slots (db_bridge, session_bridge) so agent_core's memory, consolidation, reflection, and turn-processor code can persist token usage and turn-intent state without a dependency back on session_persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a one-shot register() call to install trait-object implementations into agent_core's foundation slots, keeping the dependency edge one-directional.

nodes.name: record_token_usage_adapter
nodes.summary: Adapter that maps agent_core's TokenUsageRow into a token_usage::insert_token_usage_record call, returning the new row id.

nodes.name: map_attribution_method
nodes.summary: Maps a wire-format attribution method string to the local AttributionMethod enum.

nodes.name: record_usage_telemetry_batch_adapter
nodes.summary: Adapter that converts a batch of agent_core LLM usage spans and tool attributions into local record types and persists them via tool_usage::insert_usage_telemetry_batch.

nodes.name: map_bridge_status
nodes.summary: Maps a wire-format turn-intent status string to the local TurnIntentStatus enum.

nodes.name: map_bridge_source
nodes.summary: Maps a wire-format turn-intent source string to the local TurnIntentSource enum.

nodes.name: upsert_turn_intent_adapter
nodes.summary: Adapter that inserts or updates a turn intent record via turn_intents::upsert_initial using mapped source and status enums.

nodes.name: update_turn_intent_status_adapter
nodes.summary: Adapter that transitions a turn intent's status via turn_intents::update_status.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Installs this crate's concrete db_bridge and session_bridge implementations into agent_core's IoC container at startup.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri-command layer exposing ~23 async wrappers around the blocking SQLite CRUD, editing, and telemetry operations of this crate, each offloading work via spawn_blocking so the Tauri main thread is never blocked.
nodes.languageNotes: Commands are re-registered from app::commands::handler_list.inc under the bare session_persistence::* path rather than being invoked directly from this file.

nodes.name: cache_save_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that persists a full CachedSession via crud::save_session on a blocking thread.

nodes.name: cache_load_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that loads a cached session by id via crud::load_session.

nodes.name: cache_update_session_specs
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that updates a session's specs JSON via crud::update_session_specs.

nodes.name: cache_save_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that persists a batch of session events via crud::save_events.

nodes.name: cache_load_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that loads all cached events for a session via crud::load_events.

nodes.name: cache_load_turn_index
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that loads the materialized turn index for a session via turn_index::load_turn_index.

nodes.name: cache_search_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that performs a text search over a session's events via crud::search_events.

nodes.name: cache_search_all_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that searches events across all cached sessions via crud::search_all_sessions.

nodes.name: cache_get_session_metadata
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that fetches session metadata via crud::get_session_metadata.

nodes.name: cache_delete_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that deletes a cached session via crud::delete_session.

nodes.name: cache_clear_old_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that purges sessions older than a max age via crud::clear_old_sessions.

nodes.name: cache_get_all_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that lists all cached session ids.

nodes.name: cache_get_stats
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that returns aggregate cache stats (session/event counts, db size).

nodes.name: cache_truncate_after_event
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that truncates a session's event log after a given event via editing::truncate_after_event, backing the edit-and-resend flow.

nodes.name: cache_delete_event
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that deletes a single cached event via editing::delete_event.

nodes.name: cache_update_event
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that updates a cached event's content via editing::update_event.

nodes.name: cache_clear_session_history
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that clears a session's entire event history via editing::clear_session_history.

nodes.name: cache_get_event
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that fetches a single cached event by id via crud::get_event.

nodes.name: cache_get_session_diff
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that computes a session diff summary (event count / metadata) for a session id.

nodes.name: get_session_token_usage_records
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that returns per-round token usage records for a session via token_usage::get_token_usage_records.

nodes.name: get_session_llm_usage_spans
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that returns per-LLM-call usage spans for a session/turn via tool_usage::get_llm_usage_spans.

nodes.name: get_session_tool_usage_attributions
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that returns tool-call usage attribution records for a session/turn via tool_usage::get_tool_usage_attributions.

nodes.name: get_session_tool_usage_attributions_for_call
nodes.summary: Tauri command wrapper that returns the usage attribution record for one specific tool call via tool_usage::get_tool_usage_attributions_for_call.

nodes.name: connection.rs
nodes.summary: Thin re-export shim exposing database::db connection helpers (get_connection, begin_immediate, with_sessions_writer) under the session_persistence namespace for legacy in-crate callers.

nodes.name: crud.rs
nodes.summary: Synchronous rusqlite CRUD operations for session and event persistence -- save/load/search/delete sessions and events -- intended to be called from a blocking thread via spawn_blocking.

nodes.name: existing_event_sequence
nodes.summary: Looks up the stored sequence number for an existing event row, if any.

nodes.name: normalize_session_sequences
nodes.summary: Re-numbers a session's event sequence values to be contiguous, used after truncation or reordering.

nodes.name: save_events
nodes.summary: Persists a batch of session events, assigning sequence numbers, upserting rows, and scheduling a debounced turn-index rebuild.

nodes.name: load_events
nodes.summary: Loads all cached events for a session ordered by sequence.

nodes.name: escape_like_pattern
nodes.summary: Escapes SQL LIKE wildcard characters in a user search query.

nodes.name: build_excerpt
nodes.summary: Builds a highlighted text excerpt around the first match of a search query within event content.

nodes.name: search_events
nodes.summary: Performs a LIKE-based full text search over a session's events, returning ranked results with excerpts.

nodes.name: search_all_sessions
nodes.summary: Performs a LIKE-based search across all cached sessions' events.

nodes.name: get_session_metadata
nodes.summary: Fetches aggregate metadata (event count, time range) for a session.

nodes.name: delete_session
nodes.summary: Deletes a session and all its associated events from the cache.

nodes.name: clear_old_sessions
nodes.summary: Deletes cached sessions older than a given age threshold.

nodes.name: get_all_sessions
nodes.summary: Lists all session ids present in the cache.

nodes.name: get_cache_stats
nodes.summary: Computes aggregate cache statistics: total sessions, events, and database size.

nodes.name: update_session_metadata
nodes.summary: Recomputes and persists a session's cached metadata after event mutations.

nodes.name: save_session
nodes.summary: Persists a full session (events + specs) atomically, resetting sequence counters and rebuilding the turn index.

nodes.name: load_session
nodes.summary: Loads a full cached session including its events and specs.

nodes.name: update_session_specs
nodes.summary: Updates the stored specs JSON blob for a session.

nodes.name: find_awaiting_user_events_by_function
nodes.summary: Finds events awaiting a user response for a given tool/function name, used to resume pending interactions.

nodes.name: get_event
nodes.summary: Fetches a single cached event by session and event id.

nodes.name: editing.rs
nodes.summary: Session event log editing operations -- truncate-after-event, delete, and update -- backing the edit-and-resend chat flow used by useEditUserMessage.

nodes.name: truncate_after_event
nodes.summary: Public entry point that truncates a session's event log after the given event, delegating to truncate_after_event_inner.

nodes.name: truncate_after_event_inner
nodes.summary: Removes the target event and every later event in a session's linear history, then rebuilds the turn index.

nodes.name: select_ids_by_seq
nodes.summary: Selects event ids in a session with sequence number greater than a given value.

nodes.name: select_ids_by_ts
nodes.summary: Selects event ids in a session with timestamp greater than a given value.

nodes.name: delete_event
nodes.summary: Deletes a single event from a session's history and renormalizes metadata.

nodes.name: update_event
nodes.summary: Updates the content of an existing cached event.

nodes.name: clear_session_history
nodes.summary: Deletes all events for a session while preserving the session record itself.
